question: Ravi borrowed ₹1,380 from a bank which he repaid in 6 years at the rate of 6% per annum simple interest. If payment was made in six equal instalment, then each instalment was:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In SI installment, Total Amount = n × I + [R × I × n(n−1) ÷ 200]

Assume each installment (I) = 100%

Total units for 6 years at 6% = (6 × 100) + 6 × (5+4+3+2+1+0) = 600 + 90 = 690%

690% → ₹1,380

100% → (1380 ÷ 690) × 100 = ₹200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Debt (A) = ₹1,380

Time (n) = 6 years

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula Used:**

A = n × I + [I × R × n(n−1) ÷ 200]
